task: ADR-018 (Pairwise Preference Optimization for Discrete Action Logits), amended 2026-10-29 to the confirmed FDD-018 G1 to G7

criteria.description: architectural soundness: Re-approval after §4.2, §4.3, §4.4 and §6 were aligned with the code and a prototype: a step size that cannot overshoot (a fixed 0.1 diverged at 3000 pairs) with a matrix form and an honest convergence report, the sub-millisecond claim replaced by a measurement, overrides read from feedback_status rejected instead of the unused decision_disposition, theta_ref stored in snapshot metadata and frozen, refit semantics, the 8.0 clamp checked against max_logit_abs, no consumed inputs.
